critical_code_review_comments: Backup docs count reported by /maintenance/backup shows 457 documents but individual collection counts in dry-run preview are mostly 0 (settings:18, ai_knowledge:1, custom_strategies:1, performance:437, strategy_coin_toggles:437 etc). This is expected for the mostly empty local DB but the discrepancy between 'total docs' displayed in backup-last-run and per-collection counts might confuse users; consider a tooltip.

backup-restore dry-run preview text is long and unwrapped in the modal (spans multiple lines with '·' separators). Consider a scrollable region or grouped display for readability when many collections are present.

Restore endpoint accepts apply:true and returns status='restored' even for a collection with 0 documents (custom_strategies) which is fine, but consider surfacing 'replaced'/'inserted' counters explicitly in the UI preview after apply=true (currently only dry_run preview is shown by BackupCard).
